Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
For the work equipment listed in Annex VII of Legislative Decree 81/2008, who carries out the first periodic verification, and within what time?

response.text: Under Annex VII of Legislative Decree 81/2008, which party performs the first periodic verification of the listed work equipment, and what is the deadline for it?
